verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Time Tracking as a first-party product feature, and its official MCP server documents the ability to log time entries and manage timers, which supports the core of logging time. The evidence is thin, though: a feature label plus one MCP capability line, with nothing showing time attached to specific tasks or projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of logging time against individual tasks and projects, in-app time-entry workflow details, time-tracking API endpoint docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
